units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 26a">Ab. Zar. 26ᵃ</cite> she may smear poison <he>לד׳ מאבראי</he> on her breast outside.—Pl. <he>דַּדִּין</he>, <he>דַּדַּיָּא</he>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> (<he>חד מאת׳</he> 6) <he>ותרין מזגין אילין תרין דדיא</he> (not <cite ref="D00124"><he>דדא</he></cite>) the two bottlers (in the riddle) are the two breasts.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:20">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>יתברכון ד׳ וכ׳</he> blessed are the breasts which nursed such a son.
